title: Exploring Fractional Quantum Hall States with Deep Learning: From Abelian to Non-Abelian Phases
title_zh: 用深度学习探索分数量子霍尔态：从阿贝尔相位到非阿贝尔相位
summary: 分数阶量子霍尔系统主机拓扑相位与拓扑量子计算中的潜在应用密切相关，但识别其微观基态仍然具有挑战性，因为竞争相位通常几乎是退化的，并且朗道级混合难以处理。在这里，我们引入了一个适应对称的神经网络波函数，该波函数描述了Abelian和非Abelian状态，同时结合了所有Landau水平。该方法准确捕获复合费米子液体和低填充时Wigner结晶的出现。
abstract: arXiv:2610.38533v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Fractional quantum Hall systems host strongly correlated topological phases with potential applications in topological quantum computation, yet identifying their microscopic ground states remains challenging because competing phases are often nearly degenerate and Landau-level mixing is difficult to treat. Here, we introduce a symmetry-adapted neural-network wavefunction that describes Abelian and non-Abelian states while incorporating all Landau levels. The method accurately captures composite-fermion liquids and the emergence of Wigner crystallization at low filling. When the first Landau level is partially filled, finite-size overlaps and entanglement spectra provide evidence consistent with bar2k1k⁺¹-type parton phases at ν=4/3 and 7/5, while the ν=3/2 state exhibits anti-Pfaffian-like entanglement structure. These results demonstrate that neural-network wavefunctions offer a flexible framework for studying competing topological orders in fractional quantum Hall systems.

title: Point-Group Equivariant Neural Networks for Local Dynamics in Lattice Systems
title_zh: 格子系统中局部动力学的点群等变神经网络
summary: 我们开发了点群等变量神经网络，用于学习格系统动态模拟中使用的局部映射。相同的网络作用于每个站点周围的有限邻域，通过共享参数尊重晶格平移。局部配置被分解为根据点组的不可约表示进行变换的特征，隐藏的特征在整个网络中保留该组织。等变量线性映射和对称允许的张量积然后学习非线性空间相关性，同时保持所需的变换定律。这种方法避免了构造一组固定的手工不变描述符，这些描述符的选择需要选择保留哪些局部相关性。它还允许学习映射的复杂性在不扩大其空间截止值的情况下增长。
abstract: arXiv:2601.04104v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We develop point-group equivariant neural networks for learning local mappings used in dynamical simulations of lattice systems. The same network acts on a finite neighborhood around each site, respecting lattice translations through shared parameters. The local configuration is decomposed into features that transform according to irreducible representations of the point group, and hidden features retain this organization throughout the network. Equivariant linear maps and symmetry-allowed tensor products then learn nonlinear spatial correlations while preserving the required transformation laws. This approach avoids constructing a fixed set of hand-crafted invariant descriptors, whose selection requires choices about which local correlations to retain. It also allows the complexity of the learned mapping to grow without enlarging its spatial cutoff. We demonstrate the construction by learning the forces governing adiabatic dynamics in the square-lattice Holstein model. Comparisons with exact diagonalization test the accuracy of the predicted forces and the evolution of spatial correlations. Force evaluation scales linearly with system size, allowing the trained model to simulate charge-density-wave ordering on large lattices. These simulations reproduce anomalously slow coarsening of the charge-density-wave domains, illustrating the use of the learned local mapping for collective dynamics.

title: Interpolation of unitaries with time-dependent Hamiltonians via deep learning
title_zh: 通过深度学习对与时间相关的哈密顿量进行酉插值
summary: 由时间相关哈密顿量控制的量子系统对其酉时间演化算子的精确计算提出了重大挑战。在这项工作中，我们引入了一种基于物理信息神经网络的深度学习方法，通过直接预测时间演化算子或通过预测计算该算子的有效哈密顿量来估计全时域上的这些算子。在第一种情况下，幺正性被强加为约束，并在第二种情况下通过构造而成立，其中基于二阶马格努斯展开或 Trotterization 的传播层将预测的哈密顿量映射到演化算子。
abstract: Quantum systems governed by time-dependent Hamiltonians pose significant challenges for the accurate computation of their unitary time-evolution operators. In this work, we introduce a deep learning approach based on physics-informed neural networks to estimate these operators over the full time domain, either by predicting the time-evolution operator directly or by predicting an effective Hamiltonian from which that operator is computed. Unitarity is imposed as a constraint in the first case, and holds by construction in the second, where a propagation layer based on the second-order Magnus expansion or Trotterization maps the predicted Hamiltonian to the evolution operator. The model is trained on characterization data from a small number of times, generated numerically here but standing in for measurements on a system whose Hamiltonian is unknown to the model. The loss combines three contributions: agreement with pairs of input and evolved states, agreement with the evolution operator at the sampled times when it is available, and a unitarity constraint that requires no measured data. Systems of 2 to 8 qubits are considered, with a Hamiltonian containing all non-identity Pauli components up to 6 qubits, used as a baseline test against random dense matrices, and physically motivated nearest-neighbor Ising and Heisenberg models beyond. Across all system sizes, and using a limited number of sampled times, a statistical analysis over independent Hamiltonian realizations gives mean gate fidelities close to with low variability. Comparable fidelities are obtained when the model is trained from state data alone, without providing the evolution operator at any sampled time during training. Once trained, the model interpolates the evolution operator with inference times to lower than those of a numerical interpolation baseline based on geodesic interpolation, depending on system size and propagation method. These results support the use of the approach for data-driven simulation and identification of quantum dynamical systems.

title: Learning Between the Lines: Interaction Interpolation in a Multi Element Machine Learning Interatomic Potential
title_zh: 字里行间的学习：多元素机器学习原子间势中的交互插值
summary: 近年来，机器学习原子间势（MLIAP）的不断发展极大地加速了材料研究。然而，为每个独特问题构建定制 MLIAP 的需求仍然是一个瓶颈，这引发了 MLIAP 的可转移性问题。虽然基础 MLIAP 由于其训练集中所代表的化学空间的广泛覆盖而可以实现可转移性，但它们的大小和计算成本限制了它们的常规使用。我们通过开发一种适用于十二种元素（Al、Sc、Ti、V、Cu、Zn、Zr、Nb、Mo、Hf、Ta、W）金属合金的轻质通用 MLIAP 来解决这一差距。
abstract: arXiv:2610.38876v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The continuous development of machine learning inter-atomic potentials (MLIAPs)has greatly accelerated materials research in recent years. However, the need to con- struct custom MLIAPs for each unique problem remains a bottleneck which raises the question of the transferability of MLIAPs. While foundation MLIAPs can achieve transferability due to the broad coverage of chemical space represented in their training sets, their size and computational cost limits their routine use. We address this gap by developing a lightweight general-purpose MLIAP for metal alloys spanning twelve elements (Al, Sc, Ti, V, Cu, Zn, Zr, Nb, Mo, Hf, Ta, W). Here, we utilize a step-wise active learning (AL) approach to develop a compact yet diverse dataset and model that generalizes well by interpolating from previously seen interactions. The resulting potentials transfer effectively to unseen, higher body-order alloys systems, requiring only unary and binary training data to capture ternary and quaternary systems. The model also transfers well to new elements via an alchemical extrapolation within the network, requiring only unary data for the new element and its alloys. These findings suggest that MLIAPs trained on targeted, diversity-driven datasets provide transferability at a relatively low computational cost, offering a practical path toward general-purpose, resource-efficient MLIAPs for materials modeling.

title: Strain-Induced BCC-to-FCC Transformation in Tungsten Uncovered by Molecular Dynamics Simulations with Machine Learning Potentials
title_zh: 具有机器学习潜力的分子动力学模拟揭示了钨中应变诱导的 BCC 到 FCC 转变
summary: 少数金属会发生多晶型转变。钨不是其中之一。这一观察结果并不排除其固有的相变可能性，但可能是由于常规实验中无法达到的热力学和机械条件所致。在此，我们通过经过严格验证的机器学习势 (MLP) 分子动力学 (MD) 方法研究了钨中的体心立方 (BCC) 到面心立方 (FCC) 的转变。我们的模拟表明，应变诱导的 BCC 到 FCC 转变确实发生在钨中。在低温且存在位错的情况下，FCC 相超过 20 at.%。在完美的晶体中，适度的温度有利于相变动力学。
abstract: arXiv:2610.38477v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Polymorphic transformations occur in a minority of metals. Tungsten is not one of them. This observation does not rule out its intrinsic phase transition possibility, but may be due to inaccessible thermodynamic and mechanical conditions in conventional experiments. Herein, we investigate the body centered cubic (BCC) to face centered cubic (FCC) transformation in tungsten via a rigorously validated machine learning potential (MLP) molecular dynamics (MD) approach. Our simulations demonstrate that strain induced BCC to FCC transformation indeed occurs in tungsten. The FCC phase exceeds 20 at.% at low temperature and in the presence of dislocations. In the perfect crystal moderate temperatures favor phase transformation kinetics. Structural analysis confirms the transformation following the Bain and Nishiyama Wassermann orientation relationship. These results establish the viability of strain induced polymorphic transformation in tungsten and provide a critical guideline for the experimental production of duplex tungsten with enhanced ductility addressing a longstanding challenge in tungsten material engineering for high-temperature structural applications.

title: Transformer-inspired architectures make machine-learned electron densities accurate and transferable enough to bypass self-consistency
title_zh: 受变压器启发的架构使机器学习的电子密度精确且可转移，足以绕过自洽性
summary: 我们引入了精确预测电子密度的机器学习模型，电子密度是密度泛函理论的中心变量。它们建立在受Transformer启发的架构之上，每个参数只需要很少的计算，因此可以以低成本进行扩展。所提出的模型SwinUNETR-V2及其无需注意的对应模型NeXtUNETR在QM9上实现了最先进的准确性，密度平均值的归一化平均绝对误差分别为0.075%和0.046%。预测的密度足够准确，可以绕过自洽迭代：单个Kohn-Sham步骤再现了自洽的电子结构。
abstract: arXiv:2610.39687v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce machine learning models that accurately predict the electron density, the central variable of density functional theory. They are built on Transformer-inspired architectures, which require little computation per parameter and can therefore be enlarged at low cost. The proposed models, SwinUNETR-V2 and its attention-free counterpart NeXtUNETR, achieve state-of-the-art accuracy on QM9, with normalized mean absolute errors in the density averaging 0.075% and 0.046%, respectively. The predicted densities are accurate enough to bypass the self-consistent iteration: a single Kohn-Sham step reproduces the self-consistent electronic structure. For NeXtUNETR, the median errors are 0.036 meV in the total energy, 0.65 meV/angstrom in the forces and 1.8 meV in the HOMO-LUMO gap. The forces not only recover the self-consistent minima in geometry optimization but also successfully drive ab initio molecular dynamics. Fine-tuned on small datasets, both networks also transfer accurately to systems containing elements absent from QM9 or larger than its molecules.

title: Does System Size Matter in Uncertainty Quantification for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials?
title_zh: 对于机器学习的原子间电位，系统大小在不确定性量化中是否很重要？
summary: 机器学习原子间势（ MLIP ）通常使用不确定性估计来标记不分布（ OOD ）配置并选择主动学习的结构。一个关键问题是，在不同的系统规模下，由此产生的结构级不确定性评分是否仍然具有可比性。一种常见的做法是按原子的平均值或最大值聚合每个原子的不确定性，并将所得分数与固定阈值进行比较，并隐式假设这种可比性。我们通过将两个聚合表征为原子计数的函数，在几个分布（ ID ）/OOD对中测试这个假设。这两个聚合表现出不同的大小依赖性。
abstract: arXiv:2610.40126v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) commonly use uncertainty estimates to flag out-of-distribution (OOD) configurations and select structures for active learning. A key question is whether the resulting structure-level uncertainty scores remain comparable across different system sizes. A common practice is to aggregate per-atom uncertainties by their mean or maximum and compare the resulting score against a fixed threshold, implicitly assuming such comparability. We test this assumption across several in-distribution (ID)/OOD pairs by characterizing both aggregations as a function of atom count. The two aggregations exhibit distinct size dependencies. Mean aggregation remains size-independent for homogeneous systems but loses sensitivity to defects in large cells. In contrast, maximum aggregation grows with system size for ID systems while remaining approximately flat for defect-containing systems, narrowing the ID-OOD gap in a manner consistent with extreme-value statistics. Although highly uncertain atoms in large structures may indicate novel local environments, retraining on these structures yields little improvement, in contrast to retraining on OOD structures constructed to lie outside the training distribution. Our results reveal a practical limitation of size-unaware uncertainty criteria and motivate size-aware calibration for more reliable OOD detection in large-scale atomistic simulations.

title: AtomSteer: Test-Time Constraint Steering for Atomistic Generative Models
title_zh: AtomSteer ：原子生成模型的测试时间约束转向
summary: 扩散和流动匹配模型为生成结晶材料、分子构象体和蛋白质配体复合物提供了可扩展的方法。然而，满足晶体对称性、结构几何和精确的立体化学仍然具有挑战性。满足这些要求需要进行校正，以保留预训练模型已经捕获的几何形状。在这项工作中，我们提出了AtomSteer ，这是一个用于操纵具有结构约束的预训练原子生成模型的测试时间推理框架。在采样过程中， AtomSteer使用有界局部投影、图刚性立体化学转换和周期对称投影来校正中间结构预测，接受更新以提高约束满意度，同时限制对结构其余部分的更改。
abstract: arXiv:2610.38517v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Diffusion and flow matching models offer scalable approaches to generating crystalline materials, molecular conformers, and protein-ligand complexes. However, satisfying crystallographic symmetry, structural geometry, and accurate stereochemistry remains challenging. Satisfying these requirements calls for corrections that preserve the geometry already captured by the pretrained model. In this work, we propose AtomSteer, a test-time inference framework for steering pretrained atomistic generative models with structural constraints. During sampling, AtomSteer corrects intermediate structure predictions with bounded local projections, graph-rigid stereochemical transformations, and projections over periodic symmetries, accepting updates that improve constraint satisfaction while limiting changes to the rest of the structure. We demonstrate AtomSteer across three pretrained backbones, FlowMM, ET-Flow, and Boltz-2, spanning de novo crystal generation and crystal structure prediction, molecular conformer generation, and protein-ligand complex structure prediction. AtomSteer improves space-group distribution coverage in de novo crystal generation and improves target space-group recovery in crystal structure prediction. AtomSteer improves molecular validity and E/Z stereochemical accuracy while retaining conformer ensemble fidelity. For protein-ligand complexes, AtomSteer reduces ligand E/Z errors relative to experimental reference structures while achieving competitive docking success and PoseBusters validity. Our method provides a unified framework for adding chemical and crystallographic control to existing atomistic generative models without retraining or architectural changes.

title: Integrating Density Functional Theory, Machine Learning, and Device Simulation for Perovskite Photovoltaics: A Review
title_zh: 集密度函数理论、机器学习和设备模拟于一体的钙钛矿光伏：综述
summary: 金属卤化物和无铅双钙钛矿是下一代光伏发电的前景材料。但是，在它们巨大的组成空间中导航并同时控制长期稳定性和非辐射重组是一项挑战。本综述提供了跨尺度计算范式的关键综合，该范式将密度函数理论（ DFT ）、机器学习（ ML ）和SCAPS-1D等宏观设备模拟结合在一起。我们讨论了如何在不进行物理过度简化的情况下，将带边对齐、介电常数和有效质量等第一原理原子参数转换为有意义的器件参数。
abstract: Metal halide and lead-free double perovskites are promising materials for next-generation photovoltaics. But it is a challenge to navigate their huge compositional space and to simultaneously control long-term stability and non-radiative recombination. This review provides a critical synthesis of the cross-scale computational paradigm that brings together Density Functional Theory (DFT), machine learning (ML) and macroscopic device simulations like SCAPS-1D. We discuss how to transform first-principles atomistic parameters such as band edge alignments, dielectric constants and effective masses into meaningful device parameters without physical oversimplification. This work does not see parameter transfer as a "plug-and-play" process, but rather explains the bridging mechanisms that must be developed between microscopic energetics and macroscopic transport equations. We critically assess functional dependencies, active learning efficiencies, device-level limitations, and uncertainties related to ion migration and transient dynamics. This review provides actionable roadmap towards high-throughput physics-informed computational discovery of robust perovskite solar cells.

title: Machine learning helps track semiconductor defects under more realistic temperature conditions
title_zh: 机器学习有助于在更真实的温度条件下跟踪半导体缺陷
summary: 所有材料都含有固有缺陷。这些并不总是有害的，因为它们可用于设计并将某些特性引入材料。但是，了解它们的功能以及它们如何影响材料的性能至关重要。
abstract: All materials contain inherent defects. These are not always harmful, since they can be used to engineer and introduce certain properties into a material. However, it is crucial to understand how they function and how they affect the material's properties.

title: Differentiable Electronic Grand Canonical Learning for Electrochemistry
title_zh: 电化学的可微分电子大规范学习
summary: 电子大经典密度泛函理论捕捉了结构和电子电荷如何响应电极电位，以及与统计力学一起，这些响应如何产生突发现象。然而，其计算成本限制了第一原理模拟可访问的系统大小和采样时间。在这里，我们引入了一个可微的架构，它代表了巨大的潜力，并获得了作为其导数的力和电子电荷，完全满足热力学一致性所需的混合导数约束，并在等变量MACE框架内将其实现为GC-MACE。
abstract: arXiv:2610.40338v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electronic grand-canonical density functional theory captures how structure and electronic charge respond to electrode potential and, together with statistical mechanics, how these responses give rise to emergent phenomena. However, its computational cost limits the system sizes and sampling times accessible to first- principles simulations. Here, we introduce a differentiable architecture that represents the grand potential and obtains forces and electronic charge as its derivatives, exactly satisfying the mixed-derivative constraints required for thermodynamic consistency, and implement it within the equivariant MACE framework as GC- MACE. We demonstrate more accurate joint learning across multiple electrochemical interfaces and improved transferability to thicker water films relative to previous models, while enabling constant-potential simulations at substantially larger length and time scales than accessible to ab initio molecular dynamics. With broad training data, the framework offers a route to thermodynamically consistent foundation interatomic potentials for the electronic grand canonical ensemble

title: From MS/MS evidence to adaptive spectroscopic characterization: Reinforcement learning guided by candidate molecular structures
title_zh: 从MS/MS证据到自适应光谱表征：由候选分子结构引导的强化学习
summary: 串联质谱（ MS/MS ）的小分子鉴定可能需要补充测量。在此，我们提出了一种结构知情的深度Q网络（ SI-DQN ） ，它使用现有的MS/MS证据来决定是否需要进一步的表征、请求哪种测量以及何时停止。该政策将光谱表示和求职者排名与求职者的化学特征和结构差异的分数加权描述符相结合。使用来自多模态光谱数据集的模拟MS/MS、红外（ IR ）和核磁共振（ NMR ）光谱对79,462个保留样品进行了评估。评估使用固定的硬候选集，其中包含正确的结构和相等的归一化采集成本。
abstract: arXiv:2610.40264v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Small-molecule identification from tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) may require complementary measurements. Herein, we propose a structure-informed deep Q-network (SI-DQN) that uses existing MS/MS evidence to decide whether further characterization is needed, which measurement to request, and when to stop. The policy combines spectral representations and candidate rankings with score-weighted descriptors of the candidates' chemical features and structural differences. The policy was evaluated on 79,462 held-out samples with simulated MS/MS, infrared (IR), and nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectra from the Multimodal Spectroscopic Dataset. Evaluation used fixed hard candidate sets containing the correct structure and equal normalized acquisition costs. Averaged across three training runs, SI-DQN increased Top-1 accuracy from 80.10% to 93.78% for positive-ion MS/MS starts and from 70.44% to 93.31% for negative-ion starts. The corresponding mean additional measurement counts were only 0.227 and 0.340 per sample, respectively. Complete acquisition achieved 97.72% accuracy with four additions, whereas SI-DQN reduced the additional measurement count by 94.3% and 91.5%. Relative to a rule-based policy, SI-DQN reduced the composite loss combining terminal ranking error and acquisition cost by 19.3% and 25.5%. Adding structural information to DQN further improved accuracy while reducing requests across all three training runs. At comparable ranking uncertainty, SI-DQN increased request rates relative to DQN more strongly in groups with high structural disagreement, where larger reductions in composite loss were also observed. Together, these results support using the ambiguity among candidate structures after MS/MS analysis to guide further characterization, providing a quantitative basis for balancing identification performance against subsequent measurement effort.

title: Development and application of a machine learning potential for diamond surfaces and their sliding interfaces with silicon nitride and silica: effect of passivation, orientation and load
title_zh: 金刚石表面及其与氮化硅和二氧化硅滑动界面的机器学习潜力的开发和应用：钝化、取向和负载的影响
summary: 金刚石的摩擦和磨损由其表面化学控制，这决定了滑动界面上是否形成共价键。第一原理模拟探索了表面取向和钝化的作用，但仅限于几百个原子和几十皮秒。为了弥补这一差距，我们开发了 C/H/N/O/Si 化学空间的反应式机器学习原子间势，涵盖金刚石、氮化硅、氧化硅及其表面、界面和环境分子。该潜力在不同结构的大型数据集上进行了训练，并在多种物理特性上进行了测试，包括金刚石表面上的从头算反应势垒以及非晶 Si₃N₄ 和 SiO2 的结构/机械特性。
abstract: arXiv:2610.38937v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Friction and wear of diamond are controlled by its surface chemistry, which determines whether covalent bonds form across the sliding interface. First-principles simulations have explored the role of surface orientation and passivation, but are limited to a few hundred atoms and tens of picoseconds. To bridge this gap, we develop a reactive machine learning interatomic potential for the C/H/N/O/Si chemical space, covering diamond, silicon nitride, silicon oxide, their surfaces, interfaces, and environmental molecules. The potential is trained on a large dataset of diverse structures and is tested on multiple physical properties, including ab initio reaction barriers on diamond surfaces, and structural/mechanical properties of amorphous Si₃N₄ and SiO₂. We then simulate sliding of diamond-Si₃N₄ interfaces with four surface orientations, clean and H/OH-passivated terminations, and normal loads from 0.1 to 23 GPa. We identify two different regimes: one where sliding is localized at the interface, and shear stress is proportional to the interfacial bond density, and another where shear is distributed inside the softer material, and adhesion due to full interfacial bonding dominates. These results show how passivation, surface orientation and load together determine interfacial bonding and friction, with implications for the environmental sensitivity of diamond wear. More broadly, the potential enables reactive simulations of diamond, silicon nitride and silica with near-ab initio accuracy at length and time scales beyond first-principles methods, providing a useful tool for future studies of wear at plowing asperities, chemical-mechanical polishing, and properties of amorphous ceramic films.

title: ML-COHP: predicting bond descriptors using latent space of a universal interatomic potentials
title_zh: ML-COHP ：使用通用原子间势的潜空间预测键描述符
summary: 积分晶体轨道汉密尔顿布居 (ICOHP) 是 DFT 计算中键强度的标准度量，但每个结构都需要自己的 DFT 单点和 LOBSTER 投影，对于包含 100 个原子的细胞（例如晶界或催化纳米颗粒）而言，这需要数天的时间。我们根据 MACE 基础模型的冻结描述符来预测 ICOHP。对称对头读取两个原子的标量和键投影矢量通道，并纠正根据同一模型的元素嵌入构建的对基线。
abstract: arXiv:2610.40445v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The integrated crystal orbital Hamilton population (ICOHP) is the standard measure of bond strength in a DFT calculation, but every structure needs its own DFT single point and LOBSTER projection, which takes days for a cell of a hundred atoms, such as a grain boundary or a catalytic nanoparticle. We predict ICOHP from the frozen descriptors of a MACE foundation model. A symmetric pair head reads the scalar and bond-projected vector channels of the two atoms and corrects a pair baseline built from the element embeddings of the same model. We tested the model on the high-entropy diboride (Hf,Zr,Ti,Nb,Ta)B₂, Pt clusters on defective graphene and Pt/Pd nanoparticles with adsorbed O₂. The error on bonds stronger than 0.5 eV is 1.6-4.1%, about half that of the Gaussian-process model of Ferreira et al. trained on the same data. Trained only on high-temperature HEB₂ snapshots, the model reproduces the LOBSTER ICOHP of relaxed grain boundary cells to 0.06 eV in about a second, against 5-51 hours of LOBSTER. The vector channels halve the error compared to the scalar ones, and the baseline keeps the model usable with two training structures. With geometries from a fine-tuned MACE potential, the model gives the bonding of Pt/Pd particles over a continuous O₂ coverage, and DFT on these particles shows that O₂ costs a Pt-rich shell several times more metal--metal bonding than a Pd shell.

title: Framework-Conditional Open Materials Generation
title_zh: 框架条件开放材料生成
summary: 新型材料的理论预测依赖于多种技术，从基于数据挖掘的离子替代方法到完全从头生成模型。每种方法都会施加特定的限制，并在超越已知材料的分布来推断新材料时遇到独特的挑战。材料生成的首要目标是生产稳定、独特和新颖的 (S.U.N.) 结构。然而，满足这些标准的预测结构通常是由映射到已知结构原型或框架上的新颖化学成分产生的。我们利用这种启发式见解提出了一种新的生成范式，用于从头预测受其结构框架（即晶胞形状和各自的颗粒位置）约束的无机晶体材料。
abstract: arXiv:2610.40443v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Theoretical predictions of novel materials rely on a variety of techniques, from data-mining-based ion substitution methods to fully de novo generative models. Each approach imposes specific constraints and encounters unique challenges when extrapolating beyond the distribution of known materials to discover new ones. The foremost goal of materials generation is to produce stable, unique, and novel (S.U.N.) structures. Predicted structures that meet these criteria, however, typically result from novel chemical compositions mapped onto known structural prototypes or frameworks. We leverage this heuristic insight to present a new generative paradigm for the de novo prediction of inorganic crystalline materials constrained by their structural framework---i.e., the unit cell shapes and respective particle positions. Our method, termed OMatG-FC (Open Materials Framework-Conditional Generation), learns via a combination of discrete flow matching on the atomic species and stochastic interpolants for the volume scaling of the unit cell lattice, while fixing in-place the fractional coordinates and the unit-volume lattice vectors, dramatically reducing the dimensionality of the problem compared to unconstrained (framework-free) generation. Our method is more flexible than existing prototype-constrained methods, demonstrating capability for discovery of unseen, stable prototypes derived from known structural frameworks. We also investigate the number of unique frameworks in the MP-20 dataset, demonstrating the propensity of duplicate frameworks within the dataset and providing a framework-split version. We benchmark the performance of our model using the LeMat-GenBench suite using three ML interatomic potentials and achieve state-of-the-art S.U.N. rate below the convex hull, eschewing the need to learn atomic packings for materials discovery.

title: Variational Framework for Quantum Molecular Reaction Dynamics
title_zh: 量子分子反应动力学的变分框架
summary: 这项工作描述了基于变分原理的分子反应动力学的几何框架，其中必须求解薛定谔方程才能“了解”反应如何发生。首先，通过讨论最小作用原理和山口定理给出了数学基础。其次，我们讨论物理预备知识，包括推导动能算符（KEO）的等效原理和在一般时空中构建势能面（PES）的人工智能（AI）技术。此外，我们简化了分子系统内弯曲时空的电磁相互作用，因此，我们能够在非零曲率时空中构造核哈密顿量。这表明通过曲率引入规范场的可能性，例如圆锥形交叉点附近的核 KEO 中的附加项。
abstract: arXiv:2603.13923v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This work describes a geometric framework on molecular reaction dynamics based on the variational principle, where the Schrödinger equation must be solved to ``see'' how a reaction occurs. First, the mathematical preliminaries are given by discussing the principle of least action and the mountain pass theorem. Second, we discuss the physical preliminaries, including the principle of equivalence for deriving the kinetic energy operator (KEO) and artificial intelligence (AI) techniques to build the potential energy surface (PES) in general spacetime. Moreover, we simplified electromagnetic interactions in curved spacetime within the molecular system and consequently, we are able to construct the nuclear Hamiltonian in nonzero curvature spacetime. This indicates possibility to introduce gauge fields through the curvature, such as additional term in the nuclear KEO near a conical intersection. Third, the single-particle approximation provides a powful ansatz to solve the Schrödinger equation by variational principle. Thus, one can formulate the variational approaches for either electronic structure or quantum dynamics. In this work, based on previous discussions (it Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. bf 27 (2025), 20397) we unified them by a geometric description, where the geometric phase is naturally introduced. Finally, due to optimization characteristic of the present theory, further discussions on the present theory from optimization insight are also given, including two postulates, generative AI techniques, role of perturbation, and Markov process in optimization.

title: Generative discovery of chemical reaction networks
title_zh: 化学反应网络的生成发现
summary: 化学动力学决定分子稳定性、反应选择性和反应混合物的演变，但发现潜在的反应网络仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们介绍 ReactNexus，这是一个仅从反应物图开始的动力学引导网络探索的生成框架。生成模型提出过渡态并预测连接反应物和产物的完整反应轨迹，同时使用机器学习的原子间势进行计算验证连接性并评估电子势垒。在 10,000 个生成的候选物的分布基准上，经过密度泛函理论 (DFT) 优化和内在反应坐标验证后，80.8% 连接到输入反应物。
abstract: arXiv:2610.38236v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Chemical kinetics determines molecular stability, reaction selectivity and the evolution of reacting mixtures, but discovering the underlying reaction networks remains challenging. Here we introduce ReactNexus, a generative framework for kinetic-guided network exploration starting solely from reactant graphs. Generative models propose transition states and predict the full reaction trajectories connecting reactants and products, while calculations using a machine-learned interatomic potential verify connectivity and evaluate electronic barriers. On an in-distribution benchmark of 10,000 generated candidates, 80.8% connect to the input reactant after density functional theory (DFT) optimization and intrinsic reaction coordinate verification. The resulting networks uncover lower-barrier cooperative pathways and competition between catalyst release and catalyst-bound branches. In the examined carbocation cascades, coverage of known product precursors saturates after limited expansion and distinct entries converge onto shared intermediates, indicating a compact accessible reaction space. Network-derived candidate structures further assist mass-spectral interpretation of a complex nucleophilic aromatic substitution reaction. Together, these results establish a generative approach to reaction-network discovery and mechanistic analysis without predefined products or reaction templates.

title: Planar energetics do not determine twin persistence in nanocrystalline aluminium
title_zh: 平面能量学不能决定纳米晶铝中的孪生持久性
summary: 平面能量学是面心立方金属孪生性的标准描述符，也是原子间势的常用验证目标。在这里，我们表明他们不能确定变形孪晶是否存在于纳米晶铝中。两个机器学习势再现相同的零负载滑移曲线和紧密间隔的层状能量表面，根据相同负载下的常见分离断层前兆，预测保留的孪生覆盖率分别为 64% 和 14%。这种分歧归因于扭曲的部分核心内沿着尾部平移作用的力，这将消除外部断层。
abstract: arXiv:2610.37925v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Planar energetics are the standard descriptors of twinnability in face-centred cubic metals and the usual validation targets for interatomic potentials. Here we show that they do not determine whether deformation twins persist in nanocrystalline aluminium. Two machine-learned potentials reproducing the same zero-load slip curves and closely spaced layered energy surfaces predict, from a common separated-fault precursor under identical loading, retained twin coverage of 64% and 14%. The divergence traces to forces within distorted partial cores acting along the trailing translation that would remove an outer fault. Planar energetics do set the margin: an outer fault more than halves the incremental barrier for middle-plane shear, yet twin completion and fault removal remain separated by only 10--21 mJ mtextsuperscript-2. Whether an assembled twin persists is decided instead by the orientation of local traction relative to the full-slip bisector and by the arrival order of partial-slip fronts from the grain-boundary network.

title: Diffusion model for fast alpha-particle transport in Magneto-Inertial Fusion plasmas
title_zh: 磁惯性聚变等离子体中快速α粒子传输的扩散模型
summary: 开发了一种扩散模型来描述密集磁化 DT 聚变等离子体中的快速 α 粒子传输和限制，该模型专为磁惯性聚变条件而定制。该模型使用 Chapman-Enskog 近似从 Fokker-Planck 动力学方程导出，包括电子和离子的动态库仑摩擦。这种方法改进了早期的启发式模型 [Liberman 和 Velikovich，J. Plasma Phys。
abstract: arXiv:2610.38839v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A diffusion model is developed to describe fast alpha-particle transport and confinement in dense magnetized DT fusion plasmas, tailored to Magneto-Inertial Fusion conditions. The model, derived from the Fokker-Planck kinetic equation using the Chapman-Enskog approximation, includes dynamic Coulomb friction from electrons and ions. This approach improves upon earlier heuristic model [Liberman and Velikovich, J. Plasma Phys. 31, 369 (1984)], which, while valid in the ignition range near 5 keV, lacks accuracy at the higher temperatures ~20 keV required for high-gain Magnetized Liner Inertial Fusion (MagLIF). This paper provides explicit analytic formulas for all transport coefficients and characterizes the relationship between the alpha-particle pressure gradient and the associated Ampère force in magnetized plasmas, which are both relevant for MagLIF at high temperatures.

title: Crystoria: A Large-Scale Crystal Dataset Linking Thermodynamic and Dynamical Stability for Materials AI
title_zh: Crystoria：连接材料 AI 热力学和动态稳定性的大型晶体数据集
summary: 大规模晶体数据库使材料信息学能够获取数以百万计的结构和热力学性质，从而改变了材料的发现。然而，动态稳定性在可比较的规模上仍然很少被表征，因为它的评估比传统的结构和能量计算对计算的要求更高。这种不匹配在快速膨胀的晶体结构空间与可用于材料研究和机器学习的物理信息之间造成了严重的差距。在这里，我们介绍 Crystoria，一个大型晶体数据集，旨在为现代材料数据规模带来动态稳定性。
abstract: arXiv:2610.38195v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large-scale crystal databases have transformed materials discovery by making millions of structures and thermodynamic properties accessible to materials informatics. Yet dynamical stability remains sparsely characterized at a comparable scale because its evaluation is substantially more computationally demanding than conventional structure and energy calculations. This mismatch creates a critical gap between the rapidly expanding crystal-structure space and the physical information available for materials research and machine learning. Here we introduce Crystoria, a large-scale crystal dataset designed to bring dynamical stability to the scale of modern materials data. We construct Crystoria by systematically curating low-energy and metastable inorganic crystals, standardizing their structural identities, and combining machine-learning-accelerated structural relaxation with phonon-based dynamical screening. The resulting dataset contains 2,649,640 crystal structures, spanning 89 elements, 219 of the 230 space groups, and primitive cells containing 1-48 atoms. Among them, 1,793,353 structures (67.68%) are classified as dynamically stable, revealing substantial variation in dynamical stability across chemical and crystallographic space. By bringing dynamical stability to the scale of millions of crystal structures, Crystoria provides a physically grounded foundation for materials artificial intelligence (AI) and enables systematic exploration of the dynamical crystal landscape.
